title: WKAppBot Build Verify Workflow T3 Reference
desc: T3 reference tier. Chrome placement tolerance, skill sync rule, BUG-AUTO history.
steps: CHROME PLACEMENT TOLERANCE: DeltaSizeThreshold >= 30px (SDK Launcher PlacementValidate.cs). Core uses PlacementValidationTolerancePx=50. 10 was too tight -- Chrome outer window 18px narrower due to frame drift.

DEPLOY ALL THREE detail: Copy-Item good.exe wkappbot-core.exe -Force; Copy-Item good.exe wkappbot-core.new.exe -Force; Copy-Item good.exe wkappbot-core.exe.bak -Force. FSW watches .new.exe for hot-swap.
2026-04-30: BUG-AUTOs #66 PUMP, #67 diagnostics, #76 stderr -- low severity, covered by build verify workflow.
Skill sync split-brain: MAINTAINER must resolve ALL conflicts immediately. wkappbot skill sync --resolve <id> for each. HQ copy always wins. Never leave pending -- downstream repos silently diverge.
